about.title: about
about.text: Frontend Developer with 7 years of experience building user-friendly web applications. I work mainly with TypeScript, JavaScript, SCSS, and HTML, and I'm comfortable across several frameworks, including Lit, React, Vue, and Angular. I enjoy turning design concepts into clean, maintainable code and working with cross-functional teams to ship solutions on time. I like picking up new technologies and keeping the focus on a solid user experience.

details: Designed and built an internal web application for managing consultant assignments and tracking performance, using React and TypeScript.

Developed two web applications (Apple Music and Spotify integrations) for Volkswagen's infotainment system using Angular, TypeScript, and Jasmine for unit testing. Worked in an Agile Scrum team, coordinating closely with an external backend team and a separate UI/UX design team.

Built a web application for Global Via that lets users manage toll payments and access related services. Used React and TypeScript to implement scalable micro-frontends, improving both performance and the user experience.

Developed a web components library and a full-stack web application for BMW using the Lit framework and TypeScript. The component library powered widgets on the sales websites for BMW and MINI. I also contributed to a cockpit application that used these same components as a tool for sales agents and as a testing ground for widgets before they went live on the sales sites. The cockpit used Lit on the frontend and Node.js with Express.js on the backend, where Express also served as a proxy for all widget requests. I worked in an Agile Scrum team in close contact with both the development team and the client, which included occasional travel to the client's site for planning sessions and team-building.

Led frontend development of a web application for managing public contracts and documents, working in an Agile Scrum team and using AI tools such as Cline and Claude to speed up development. Built with Vue 3, Vuetify, and TypeScript, working alongside a UX/UI designer to translate their Figma design system into the frontend. Also contributed to the backend (Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL), gaining full-stack experience.
